messages:
chloe_cs: Heads-up 1 Borealis procurement wants to split a 10-seat midterm add across the UK subsidiary and US parent; they want net60 for UK and net30 for US, and insist on a wet-sign for the UK amendment. PO uploaded uses parent name only. Can Billing + Legal advise?
sam_sales: We can split seats. Need effective date to prorate and confirm seat rate. Also need manager ok for net60 on UK side.
karen_fin: Split invoices OK. For net60 we need AR approval; that'll be an exception. Also need VAT ID for UK entity and bank details if they want a different remit. If PO references parent, we'll request corrected PO or a mapping table.
alan_legal: Wet-sign for UK accepted as scanned signature page with attestation. I'll prepare clause: "Scanned wet-signed signature page from an authorized signatory shall bind the UK amendment." Prefer to avoid courier.
chloe_cs: Customer: effective date = 2024-04-15, seats = 10, seat rate = $1,100/seat/yr, all 10 to UK entity going forward. They want historical invoices kept on parent.
sam_sales: Manager tentatively ok for net60 on UK if credit check passes. I'll escalate.
karen_fin: Please collect VAT ID + corrected PO by 2024-04-10 to hit billing. We'll prepare sample invoice lines and note net60 exception.
docu_sign_bot: DocuSign envelope queued: borealis-uk-split-2024. Set to manual upload for wet-sign per Legal.
chloe_cs: I'll ask procurement for VAT + signatory and send the mapping table. Will update thread when they reply.
alan_legal: Draft amendment to include mapping table and attestation. Can review and return within 24h of draft upload.
sam_sales: Noted. Will follow up with manager on net60 exception and credit check.
chloe_cs: Thanks team. I'll push procurement and update once we have PO + VAT and scanned signatory. :thumbsup:
